description:
Your grand adventure begins in your own backyard with just a shovel and a dream. In this simple yet addictive simulator, your mission is simple: Dig as deep as you can! Carve out your own vertical tunnel, navigate the underground world, and unearth the valuable stones and colourful gems buried deep beneath your feet.

But digging is exhausting work, and your backpack has limited capacity. Once your pockets are full or your energy is low, it's time to head back to the surface. Take your hard-earned cash to the garage to upgrade your equipment. Increase your shovel’s digging power, expand your backpack's capacity, and boost your maximum stamina so you can dig for longer periods of time. Best of all, buy and upgrade a reliable jetpack so you can easily fly right back up from the deepest, darkest holes!
